long: Unreal Tournament 2004 is an arena first-person shooter expanding its predecessor with vehicle-based Onslaught and Assault modes alongside classic Deathmatch and Capture the Flag. It offers a bot-driven single-player ladder plus extensive online and LAN multiplayer. It was developed by Epic Games and Digital Extremes and published by Atari; this build uses the OldUnreal native Linux patch.
name: Unreal Tournament 2004
